action_label: Add an employee to the machines
description:
What this is. A new employee cannot clock in until the machines know about them. Saving a new employee offers to send them down to the machines straight away.

What to do. Open the person, then use Biometric Device › Add to Device and pick which machines they should be on. If you change the number they scan with, their records move across with them — you do not have to re-enrol.

Where to find it. Employee, under HR.
name: Add an Employee to the Devices
title: Employee — add them to the machines
